message: No detected untrusted source handling: The code reads data only from local filesystem paths with no remote fetching, so there is no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check for any remote source.

No detected label flipping detection: The code validates that expected directories exist and remaps unknown labels, but does not compare label distributions, validate label values against an expected set post-assignment, or use any label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious audio samples is performed on the training data before or during preparation.

No detected model integrity verification: The code creates a new model from config via create_network_from_config and does not load pretrained weights or serialized models; there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision anywhere in the pipeline.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses plain Keras model.fit_generator with RMSProp and no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or invoked anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a validation split is performed in DataReader, there is no isolated held-out test set separate from the validation set used during training, no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no use of multiple independent metrics beyond loss and accuracy.

No detected input sanitization: The DataReader._validate_input() checks for directory existence and sample directories but does not validate audio input shape, value ranges, or malformed file contents before passing data to the model during inference.

No detected output bounds checks: The code calls model.predict() in the visualize path but performs no sanity checks on the output probabilities (e.g., NaN guards, range checks, or threshold validation) before using them.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is an audio classification RNN model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
